abstract: Risk of malignant transformation in a dysgenetic gonad is high. This is a report of a 23 year-old female who presented with symptoms and signs of ovarian neoplasm which was histologically confirmed as embryonal carcinoma. She had features of Turner's syndrome and was found to have XO chromosomal constitution. Embryonal carcinoma arising in a dysgenetic gonad is uncommon. It is even rarer when it arises in a patient with pure 45 XO. The following is a case report which highlights the role of chemotherapy and surgery in the management. It includes a literature review on the clinical features, genetic variants and malignant transformation in dysgenetic gonad. The role of prophylactic removal of dysgenetic gonad is discussed.
abstract_ja: 発生異常性性腺における悪性転化のリスクは高い。23歳女性が卵巣腫瘍の症状と徴候を呈して受診し、組織学的に胎児性癌と確認された症例を報告する。患者はターナー症候群の特徴を有し、XO染色体構成であった。純粋な45,XOの患者で、発生異常性性腺に胎児性癌が生じることは稀である。本症例報告は、治療における化学療法と外科的治療の役割を強調するものである。発生異常性性腺における臨床的特徴、遺伝的変異、悪性転化に関する文献的考察を含む。発生異常性性腺の予防的摘出の役割についても論じた。
